identity.note: Static public render logic inspected. No authenticated character payload or real character DOM was accessed.

formulas.gear: Observed numerical values and lines; bonuses plus reviewed polish fallback when lines are absent
formulas.sets: Current full/classic thresholds; TR tier values with capScale, no upgrade multiplier on set steps
formulas.rewards: Normal/paid split from observed mods and derived gear bonuses; cap 100 percentage points + paid cap 50
formulas.harcero: Unsupported full-combination model: optimizer disabled; current observed value may be displayed
formulas.hpDefence: Delta projection from observed values and mods: always partial
formulas.drop: No gear drop stat in the reviewed pool or unique effects; retains current equipment

constraints: Unknown IDs, flags, set/unique membership or fields stop analysis
Same template never replaces instance identity
Only owned and usable items are searched
Conservative empty bag-cell requirement for unequip before replacement
A request shape does not prove server authorization or atomicity
